allies.rationale_text: Reframing-perspective gives lateral-thinking a practical way to reopen option space by changing the question before changing the answer.
allies.source_quote: Works when the blockage is conceptual, not effort-based.
allies.affinity_rationale: Reframing IS the core mechanism through which lateral thinking generates novel solutions — 'comfort with ambiguity and the willingness to begin like a beginner to suppress assumptions'.
allies.activation_condition: When a problem requires suspending existing causal theories and generating genuinely new frames rather than optimizing within the current problem definition

antagonists.rationale_text: Einstellung-effect undermines lateral-thinking by causing the brain to default to the most available existing mental map, directly blocking the exploration of novel or difficult solution spaces.
antagonists.source_quote: The tendency to use an existing mental map because it is readily at hand (availability bias) or to substitute a simple, familiar model for a more complicated, actual one (substitution bias) directly blocks the exploration of novel or difficult solution spaces, leading to disastrously wrong solutions.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: The tendency to use an existing mental map 'because it is readily at hand directly blocks the exploration of novel or difficult solution spaces, leading to disastrously wrong solutions'.
antagonists.activation_condition: When a familiar framework is applied reflexively to a genuinely novel problem, blocking exploration of the unconventional solution space that lateral thinking requires

antagonists.rationale_text: Anchoring undermines lateral-thinking by fixing attention on the first piece of information encountered, cutting off the flow of divergent ideas before alternative frames can form.
antagonists.source_quote: Anchoring Bias: Focusing too much on an initial piece of information, thereby cutting off the flow of better, more divergent ideas.
antagonists.affinity_rationale: Focusing too much on an initial piece of information 'thereby cutting off the flow of better, more divergent ideas' — anchoring constrains the divergent exploration lateral thinking demands.
antagonists.activation_condition: When an initial framing or data point narrows the solution space before lateral exploration has had a chance to generate genuinely alternative perspectives

structured_tensions.tension_text: Lateral-thinking conflicts with representativeness-heuristic when familiar pattern match suppresses alternative framing.
structured_tensions.source_quote: lateral-thinking vs representativeness-heuristic: lateral-thinking conflicts with representativeness-heuristic (representativeness heuristic) when familiar pattern match suppresses alternative framing.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Lateral-thinking conflicts with status-quo-bias when default playbooks crowd out unconventional options.
structured_tensions.source_quote: lateral-thinking vs status-quo-bias: lateral-thinking conflicts with status-quo-bias (status quo bias) when default playbooks crowd out unconventional options.

structured_tensions.tension_text: Lateral-thinking conflicts with confirmation-bias when teams seek only information that supports the existing frame.
structured_tensions.source_quote: lateral-thinking vs confirmation-bias: lateral-thinking conflicts with confirmation-bias (confirmation bias) when teams seek information that confirms the existing frame rather than opening to unconventional alternatives.
